purpose: City-specific registry/map source review and bounded safe route inspection for the WUP ranked settlement point.
primaryPublisher: Government of Bihar, Department of Revenue and Land Reforms / Directorate of Land Records and Survey
registryBasis: Government of Bihar district administration identifies Barharia as a block/circle under Siwan Sadar, while the official Bihar BhuNaksha viewer’s anonymous hierarchy includes Siwan/Siwan Sadar/Barharia circle and mauza. This confirms local map inventory presence, but not exact WUP-point geometry.

officialSources.observation: Official district site lists Barharia block under Siwan Sadar subdivision.
Official district administrative table lists Barharia panchayat/block.
Directorate of Land Records and Survey site lists public Online Map service.
Public official BhuNaksha Bihar landing page and map viewer; anonymous state selector value 10.
Public client script documents the WMS image layers and plot selection/detail calls. It does not expose a vector geometry-only response contract; feature routes were not invoked.

searchQueries.query: Barharia Siwan Bihar official cadastral map land records GIS public revenue map
searchQueries.scope: Find a city-specific primary registry source and a safe anonymous geometry-only route.
searchQueries.result: The official Siwan district site places Barharia block under the Siwan Sadar subdivision and lists Barharia panchayat. The official Bihar BhuNaksha portal is anonymous; its selector hierarchy lists Siwan district, Siwan Sadar subdivision, Barharia circle (code 09), and Barharia mauza (code 0723). Static client code shows the map rendered via WMS and plot click/search calls return plot IDs/details through separate routes. No feature/plot query was made and no vector geometry-only endpoint or full polygons were verified. WMS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 500.
searchQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search plus direct anonymous inspection of official public routes.

requestEvidence.observation: Anonymous public landing page; final URL resolved to /10/index.jsp.
Public View Map transition with only static state=10 selector; no parcel identifier or personal data.
Static client inspection found WMS layers VILLAGE_MAP and PLOT_LIST; plot clicks route to MapInfo/getPlotAtXY and ScalarDatahandler OP4, which were not called.
Administrative selectors only: Siwan district code 16 -> Siwan Sadar code 01 -> Barharia circle code 09 -> Barharia mauza code 0723. No parcel number was selected.
WMS metadata request failed; no GetFeature or GetFeatureInfo query made.
